name: The Last Day In Ponyville
source:
This is your first and last time in Ponyville, a place once filled with kind and charismatic ponies.

But now, it has been scarred by a tragic turn of events: the mysterious disappearance of several prominent residents—most notably Princess Celestia, the ruler of Equestria.

You, a pony with little prior knowledge of the town, decide to investigate what is truly happening in Ponyville and why there have been no visitors since the incident.

What you don't know is that Pinkie Pie is the only resident left alive in Ponyville; she is the only one who hasn't vanished, yet she has undergone an utterly bizarre transformation amidst it all.

Her signature mane—once bouncy and full of life—is now dull, straight, and colorless. She is a pony who invites others over, yet those who accept the invitation are never seen again.
translation:
这是你第一次、也是最后一次踏足小马谷——这片曾经住满了善良又充满魅力的小马们的乐土。

然而如今，一场惨痛的变故给这里留下了深深的伤痕：多位知名居民离奇失踪——其中最引人瞩目的，便是小马利亚的统治者宇宙公主。

此前对这座小镇知之甚少的你，决定亲自调查小马谷究竟发生了什么，以及为何自变故发生以来再无任何访客踏足此地。

但你浑然不知的是，碧琪已是小马谷里唯一还活着的居民；她是唯一没有凭空消失的小马，却也在这场剧变之中发生了诡异莫名的异变。

她那标志性的鬃毛曾经蓬松欢快、充满生机，如今却干瘪顺直、褪尽了所有色彩。她依然热情地邀请客人们去家里做客——然而所有应邀前往的访客，从此再也没有出现过。
